proposals.evidence: The response consists of kam work plus kor-/kar- do, compared with Turner karman and karoti, both with explicit eastern comparanda. The two lexical members are represented in order, including the Hajong fused spellings and Bishnupriya infinitive ending; no work-only link is substituted for the whole expression.
